WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product top
        ON top.product_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE top.product_number = 'BK-M38S-38'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        bom.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN product comp
        ON comp.product_id = bom.component_id
       AND comp.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b
        ON b.assembly_id = comp.product_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0) AS quantity
FROM bom
JOIN product p
    ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'NI-4127';

WITH RECURSIVE
valid_bom AS (
    SELECT
        assembly_id,
        component_id,
        COALESCE(per_assembly_qty, 0) AS per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
bom AS (
    SELECT
        c.product_id AS component_id,
        v.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        CAST(p.product_id AS VARCHAR) || ',' || CAST(c.product_id AS VARCHAR) AS path
    FROM product p
    JOIN valid_bom v ON v.assembly_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product c ON c.product_id = v.component_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T44U-46'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.product_id,
        bom.qty * v.per_assembly_qty,
        bom.path || ',' || CAST(c.product_id AS VARCHAR)
    FROM bom
    JOIN product cur ON cur.product_id = bom.component_id
    JOIN valid_bom v ON v.assembly_id = bom.component_id
    JOIN product c ON c.product_id = v.component_id
    WHERE cur.make_flag = true
      AND (',' || bom.path || ',' NOT LIKE '%,' || CAST(c.product_id AS VARCHAR) || ',%')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0)
FROM bom
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'LR-2398';
```

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        parent_code,
        child_code,
        COALESCE(qty, 0) AS qty,
        [parent_code, child_code] AS path
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ce.parent_code,
        ce.child_code,
        bom.qty * COALESCE(ce.qty, 0),
        bom.path || [ce.child_code]
    FROM bom
    JOIN u_composition AS ce
      ON ce.parent_code = bom.child_code
    WHERE ce.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (ce.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= ce.valid_to)
      AND NOT list_contains(bom.path, ce.child_code)
      AND bom.child_code IN (
          SELECT product_number
          FROM product
          WHERE make_flag = TRUE
      )
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_quantity
FROM bom
WHERE child_code = 'LR-2398';

WITH canada_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM sales_order AS o
    JOIN sales_territory AS t
        ON o.territory_id = t.territory_id
    WHERE (t.name = 'Canada' OR t.country_code = 'CA')
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        l.order_qty,
        p.product_number
    FROM sales_order_line AS l
    JOIN canada_orders AS o
        ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN product AS p
        ON l.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand), 0) AS total_demand
FROM (
    SELECT sl.order_qty AS demand
    FROM sold_lines AS sl
    WHERE sl.product_number = 'PD-R853'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT sl.order_qty * ue.qty AS demand
    FROM sold_lines AS sl
    JOIN u_explosion AS ue
        ON ue.root_code = sl.product_number
       AND ue.item_code = 'PD-R853'
       AND sl.order_date >= ue.valid_from
       AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR sl.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
) AS d
;
```
